premises.text: Ingredient-to-skin-type matching plus ML product fit solves what to put on your face
premises.evidence_span: match ingredients with someone's skin type, and then use machine learning to find out what products best fit, we can probably solve this problem

premises.text: Machines can learn skincare better than humans over time
premises.evidence_span: we truly believe that machine can learn better than human over time

premises.text: Onboarding questions and photo narrow product set by preferences; quiz assigns skin profile
premises.evidence_span: This allows the system to categorize a small set of product based on your preferences. And then it walks you through a fun quiz that's similar to a dermatologist visit. This allows the system to categorize what kind of skin profile you have

premises.text: Backend divides people into more than 30 skin types on five dimensions
premises.evidence_span: we've divided people into more than 30 different skin types based on five dimensions

premises.text: Human advisor validates system output and narrows to one recommended product
premises.evidence_span: it sends all these skin data to a real human advisor who will do a cross-check, validate the system, and then narrow it down to one product and send it to me

premises.text: Purchase completes through a personal checkout link supporting major payment methods
premises.evidence_span: I get a personal checkout link, which I can use Apple Pay, PayPal, or any credit card to finish checkout process
